sam: heads-up, onboarding Kestrel13B (hf conversion from ggml) — int4 quant + sharded kvcache produces fluent but factually wrong long summaries. short-context evals fine. logs attached.

rita: paste conversion/quant commands?

sam: 
``n# convert
python3 convert_gguf.py --in kestrel13b.gguf --out kestrel13b.hf --format hf --rotary=scaled
# quant
python3 quant.py --input kestrel13b.hf --out kestrel13b.int4 --bits 4 --group-size 128 --per_head
```

oscar: nice. did you run tokenizer roundtrip and embedding checksum?

sam: tokenizer roundtrip ok. embedding checksum matches. odd thing: runtime traces show repeated token ids in kvcache for one shard only during long decode. e.g. kv_idx: 0..127,128..255 then a repeat 128..255 again in shard-2.

oscar: that suggests shard offset not incremented for that device. is gating code that advances shard_base guarded by a size_t vs int mismatch?

rita: is this reproducible in fp16?

sam: no, fp16 + sharding is fine. int4 packed path appears to trigger it.

qa-bot: Kestrel13B | eval/summarize_longctx | fp16: ROUGE-L 44.3 | int4_shard: ROUGE-L 37.9 | int4_noshard: ROUGE-L 43.7

oscar: remote hypothesis: packer compresses KV rows into 32-byte words and computes shard offsets using (row_index / pack_gran). if pack_gran divides shard_stride then one shard may be given stale base when packer flips endian/vec path. check packer code where it does `base += (rows / pack_gran)` vs `(rows + pack_gran -1)//pack_gran`.

rita: can you dump low-level memory map of kv pointers when you hit the repeat? a short trace will be enough.

sam: attached trace: shows shard0 base 0, shard1 base 128, shard2 base 256 but during the failing loop shard2 base becomes 128 again. investigating where base variable is mutated.

oscar: reopen runtime PR that touched grouped-pack/d2i kernels last month — suspicious.

rita: mitigation plan: 1) disable sharding for Kestrel13B int4 by model config 2) add assertion in sharded loader to ensure monotonic shard_base 3) add unit test covering pack_gran stride equal to shard_stride with odd sequence lengths.

sam: I'll upload noshard int4 artifact and run nightly. placed artifact at gs://redwood-models/kestrel13b/178555/

bench-bot: Kestrel13B | eval/summarize_longctx | int4_noshard: ROUGE-L 43.7 (regression largely resolved)

oscar: good. I'll prepare a minimal reproducer and a bisect patch for the packer change. propose labeling as urgent since a Dedicated customer was about to use the sharded int path.

rita: also add an Optimize CI step that runs long-context summary for any sharded-quant onboarding. add matrix rows for seq_len [1024,4096] and quant [int8,int4].

sam: thanks team. creating PR with reproducer + failing trace and blacklisting config. leaving notes in #4879. :white_check_mark:
